name: Sheela Foam Ltd
tagline: India's largest PU-foam/mattress maker (Sleepwell) - large-cap with persistently weak ROCE/ROE and no identified structural inflection this pass; fast writeup, no forum deep-dive per large-cap default.
business_overview: Sheela Foam manufactures polyurethane foam, mattresses and related sleep/home products under the Sleepwell brand, plus international operations (Joyce Foam/Feetu, Kurl-on post-acquisition). Seeded via X triage (untrusted, @Disciplined_Inv, high conviction, 2026-09-13).
fundamentals_narrative: Management has stated targets of 10-12% EBITDA margin and 20-25% ROCE within three years, but current ROCE (~5.4%) and ROE (~4-5%) are far below that aspiration and below what a large-cap re-rating case needs. Balance sheet is conservative (low, falling debt) but that alone does not offset weak capital efficiency. No specific named management action or structural inflection (e.g., a confirmed capacity/margin step-change already underway, not just a stated target) was found in this pass.
technical_read: Not pulled - large-cap fast pass; not a factor in the verdict.
sentiment_summary: No forum deep-dive performed - large-cap default (no confirmed structural inflection found).
bse_notes: No red flags identified this pass.
bull_case: Market leader in organised mattress/foam category with a recognised brand (Sleepwell)
Low and falling debt; management has articulated a margin/ROCE improvement target
bear_case: Current ROCE (~5.4%) and ROE (~4-5%) are well below management's own stated 3-year targets - the improvement is aspirational, not yet realised
No confirmed, named structural inflection found this pass to distinguish this from a slow, uncertain turnaround
Large-cap size limits the magnitude of return even if the turnaround succeeds
verdict_headline: Large-cap mattress/foam leader with weak current ROCE/ROE (~5% each) against management's own unrealised 20-25% ROCE target and no confirmed structural inflection this pass - thesis_fit 'neither', conviction Low-Medium.
verdict_reasoning: Large-cap default rule applied: tam scored 'no' absent a specific named inflection; no forum deep-dive performed
Weak current capital efficiency versus management's own stated aspirational targets keeps conviction capped at Low-Medium

four_box.note: Large-cap default: no confirmed named structural inflection; brand/scale gives a weak moat but current returns are weak and valuation is not obviously cheap against that.
